causal_paths.input: Current tenant, project reference, and fixed scene
transitions: Binding API scopes by tenant and project

causal_paths.input: Release submission for a server-derived scene
transitions: Start workflow and persist round within the submission transaction
outputs: Successful IN_REVIEW submission or atomic conflict without partial state

causal_paths.input: Submission followed by a later binding change
transitions: Round stores actual definition ID, version, and instance
Later update changes only binding row
outputs: Existing round identity remains unchanged; later submission uses new binding

causal_paths.input: Create, update, unbind, or stale binding write
transitions: Append before/after history with operator, reason, and time
outputs: Queryable audit history or conflict on stale write

transitions: Count all published versions and all instances
Apply lifecycle transition only when guards pass
outputs: Protected history and active bindings, or allowed pure-draft deletion
